title: orbitopt multi-spacecraft mission contract v1.0
description: Mission-level contract for two or more spacecraft flying one coordinated scenario (E12-01, task #391): a mission-wide shared reference (one frame + one epoch counted on one timescale, the same Epoch/FRAMES vocabulary as handoff-state-1.0), the spacecraft roster with mandatory Target/Chaser roles, optional named zones, and the multi-body event vocabulary (maneuver / hold_point_arrival / zone_entry / zone_exit). Trajectory data is NOT in this document: each spacecraft's track reuses the FlightResult v1 BodyTrack format (orbitopt.flightlab.contract.BodyTrack) and is bound to this mission by orbitopt.mission.multispacecraft.validate_mission, which fails the shared-frame / shared-epoch / unit-coherence gates. Structural rules JSON Schema can express live here; cross-references (unique ids, exactly one TARGET, event/zone references) are checked by orbitopt.mission.multispacecraft. Compatibility policy: adding optional fields is not a breaking change; removing/renaming/narrowing is and gets multi-spacecraft-mission-2.0.json.

frame.description: The ONE frame every spacecraft state, track and event of this mission is expressed in (GCRS recommended). Mixing frames across spacecraft is a validation failure, not a conversion hint.

spacecraft.description: The roster: at least two distinct spacecraft. Exactly one must carry role TARGET and at least one role CHASER (checked by validate_mission; the schema cannot count).

zones.description: Named spherical regions the event vocabulary refers to (keep-out spheres, approach corridors, hold-point volumes). Optional; zone_entry/zone_exit events may only name a declared zone.

events.description: Multi-body events scheduled/observed on the mission timeline, ordered by nothing here (the reader sorts). Optional.

metadata.description: Free-form producer annotations. Optional; readers must not depend on any particular key.

epoch.description: Mission epoch: the shared time origin every spacecraft's tracks are aligned to. MJD2000 day-labels plus the mandatory timescale (orbitopt.timescales convention; comparisons via Epoch.to_tdb_seconds).

vec3.description: Three finite numbers (finiteness enforced by orbitopt.mission.multispacecraft).

spacecraft_id.description: Unique within the mission; matches BodyTrack.body_id of this spacecraft's trajectory.

role.description: Mandatory -- a spacecraft without a role (or with any other role) is a validation failure. Exactly one TARGET per mission; at least one CHASER.

name.description: Unique within the mission; referenced by zone_entry/zone_exit events.

center_m.description: Zone centre in the mission frame, metres -- same frame/origin as every track.

spacecraft_id.description: The acting spacecraft; must be on the roster (validate_mission).

counterpart_id.description: Optional second member for two-body events (e.g. which hold point / which counterpart the maneuver closes on).

kind.description: The multi-body event vocabulary. Single-spacecraft ascent kinds (meco, separation, ...) stay in the Flight Lab vocabulary; these are the rendezvous-mission ones.

zone.description: Mandatory for kind zone_entry/zone_exit; must name a declared zone.

data.description: Free-form event payload (delta-v magnitude, corridor axis, ...).
